Thasan Sakthi, a retired photographer, took the picture in Sri Lanka and was pleased with the human-like expression on the monkey's face. Sakthi has traveled extensively and enjoys sharing his photos, including this one which received high praise from a camera club judge and positive feedback online. \\"

\\" Maho beach is known for its close encounters with airplanes, and a recent tourist video captured the incredible sight of a plane approaching Princess Juliana International Airport in slow motion, dwarfing the tourists below and passing close to a taxi as it lands. Planes are required to fly low when approaching the airport, making the area popular with plane spotters and tourists who flock to surrounding bars and restaurants to watch the landings. The short runway of 2,300 meters requires planes to land near the start of it, creating the illusion of a near-touchdown for observers on the beach. \\"

\\" Shenyang's night market in Liaoning, China is the largest in Asia and stretches 1.2 miles. The market offers a wide range of hot and cold foods, homewares, and traditional dress. It is an opportunity for tourists and locals to practice their bartering skills with stallholders, and the atmosphere is one of fun and fashion.\\"

\\" A museum in Japan is celebrating the opening of its Deadly Poison Exhibition with a unique menu featuring a deep-fried frog sandwiched between a black bun burger, as well as a less adventurous frog egg sweet dessert. The limited-edition dish is priced at 1,000 yen (around £4.50) and features a less toxic frog than the exhibition's counterparts, while the black bun is dyed with bamboo charcoal. The exhibition, which includes live poisonous animals from around the world, runs from March 21 to May 17 and also includes a tamer Frog Egg Sweet dessert option priced at 580 yen (£3.17).\\"

\\" To get a closer look at animals in their natural habitat, visitors can visit a drive-through zoo like Olympic Game Farm in Washington. Some animals, like the buffalo, are very friendly and may even stick their heads inside car windows to get food or give a lick. One woman got a close encounter with a buffalo that leaned into her car while she was feeding it, causing her to scream in excited panic.\\"
